# Wickra Synth

> Deterministic synthetic market microstructure — OHLCV candles, order-book snapshots, trades and funding from a single seed, byte-identical across ten languages. A GenSpec is data, not code; a fixed portable PRNG (SplitMix64 seeding xoshiro256++) lives only in the Rust core, so a given seed yields the byte-for-byte identical stream on every platform and through every binding.

Wickra Synth builds a serde `GenSpec` (a seed, a bar count, a start price, a list of regimes and a microstructure block) and generates a full synthetic market. The core logic lives in one Rust crate and is reachable from Rust, Python, Node.js, WASM and — over a C ABI — C, C++, C#, Go, Java and R, plus a reference CLI. Output mirrors the JSON shapes of the rest of the ecosystem, so it feeds a backtest, a feature build or an RL environment unchanged. Released under the MIT OR Apache-2.0 license.

## Source and packages
- [GitHub](https://github.com/wickra-lib/wickra-synth): Source, issues, and releases.
- [crates.io](https://crates.io/crates/wickra-synth): Rust crate.
- [PyPI](https://pypi.org/project/wickra-synth/): Python package.
- [npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/wickra-synth): Node package.

## Ecosystem
- [Wickra](https://wickra.org): The core streaming-indicator library the ecosystem is built on.
- [Docs](https://docs.wickra.org): Documentation for the Wickra core.
